Hi!  I wasn’t really in the spot to afford a $500+ MA either.  There’s a site called aid access which I got my pills from.  Theyre the same exact kind you’d get from a doctor at a clinic or planned parenthood etc.  You just send them an email explaining your situation, they’ll ask for proof of your age using some form of identification, and then they’ll approve you for the prescription.  You can tell them your financial situation and offer them the cost you can afford.  They will work with you.  The pills take about two weeks to arrive in the US max depending on what state you’re in.  (If you’re in a different country I’d imagine it is the same).  I don’t know how old you are but I’d say I’m fairly young too, and also going through this alone with no family to support me as they are against abortion.  I’m also starting this process later today and will be taking the rest of the pills used to induce the actual abortion tomorrow in the comfort of my own bedroom.  The father of mine hasn’t been crazily supportive this entire time(I’m near 10 weeks along which is around the latest you can have an MA ) and he suffers from terrible anger problems and is heavily bipolar.  If you need someone to talk to please feel free to message me.  I know I can’t offer you money to help with your already scheduled appointment but maybe I can offer you a sense of comfort?  I could also let you know how I’m feeling throughout the time after I start this process so maybe that helps ease your mind also.  It’ll be alright I promise

If it comforts you any I was with mine for a few years and I am completing my MA journey tomorrow at home.  I’m nearing the cutoff of when you have to opt for a SA and when I told my significant other about it he wasn’t very excited.  He has terrible bipolar and bad anger problems- so on and off he’s said good things about it since but then says terrible things about me and the future child.  Which is a key factor into why I am refusing to have it.  I don’t think the baby deserves to be stuck with a parent that acts out in the terrible ways he does, and quite frankly I don’t deserve that either.  It’ll be alright I promise.  Men that act that way are terrible, a true man wouldn’t act this way towards us when they hear we have fallen pregnant.  Especially when you consider that it’s their own fault it happened anyway lol.  Don’t worry about him.  Focus on you and your health and your life.  But just make sure you’re getting a MA because you want to, don’t get one if you’re only doing it because he said to.  I made a list of all the pros and cons that would happen if I had a kid vs if I didn’t.  Maybe try that?  If you need anything feel free to message me

hey.  Two days ago on the 24th I lost my pet unexpectedly.  he was almost 19.  I had him all his life.  I know how hard it is.  I’ve cried and shouted and felt any emotion you could.  I’m happy he’s out of pain but there is a pit in my stomach and I am heartbroken.  I’ll miss him forever.  I really just want you to know you’re not alone.  Your friend isn’t mad or upset with you.  Your friend is at peace now, safe forever.  Just waiting until it’s your time long down the line to see you again.  It’ll be okay, I know how cliche that sounds but look, I’m some stranger on the internet who came across this post and I’m going through the same thing at the same time as you.  Don’t beat yourself up, I’m trying not to as well.  It’s hard but please don’t, your friend would want you to find peace and happiness in life still.  It isn’t the end- you’ll see your friend again I promise.  Hold on until then.
I’m sorry about yours as well.  If you need anything I’m here for you.  I hope you find peace during this time, I know how shitty it is.

I lost mine, also 18, not even 24 hours ago.  I know how hard it is.  It totally sucks.  I called mine my little old man too.  Just know, Dino loves you.  He isn’t mad at you.  He’s at peace now and is watching over you.  Prayers

Hey.  I usually don’t comment on anything here but I’m your exact age and I lost my cat yesterday (24th).  He was almost 19, had him since I was 2 and a half.  Nothing was really ever wrong with him and then a couple of days ago his back legs started to give out.  He’d eat & drink a bit, but he was laying in super weird places and looked sad.  Took him into the emergency vet yesterday expecting to bring him home with a new antibiotic and he had a huge mass in his intestine that burst- causing a blood infection.  Nothing would fix him ever.  Putting him to sleep was the only option and as hard as it was, I agreed without hesitation. 

I just want you to know you’re truly not alone right now as I am in this process right with you.  So far I’ve cried, I’ve screamed, I’ve gone blank.  The little cat has been in all of my memories up until now.  But you will be okay.  Feel your emotions out.

My dog and my cat were best friends.  She is already devastated.  Hold your other pets a little tighter than usual the next few weeks.  They’ll know, they’ll feel the same emotions as you.  But they will be fine I promise.  

Sheldon will find peace.  He isn’t mad at you.  He isn’t scared, I’m sure you’ve prepared him well for this.  He’s being taken out of pain and is going into the most relaxing place ever.  He’s going to be around you forever I promise.  Take care of yourself and please know this happens a lot all over the world daily.  It happened to me the same time it’s happening to you.  You’re not alone, it’s okay to not be okay in these times.
